chunks.title: [FIXTURE] France on vaccine technology transfer
chunks.text: FIXTURE: France supports voluntary technology transfer for vaccines through regional manufacturing hubs and opposes mandatory waivers of intellectual property. France will vote for texts that fund regional production and against texts that impose compulsory licensing.

chunks.title: [FIXTURE] France on financing
chunks.text: FIXTURE: France backs a pooled procurement fund administered by WHO with transparent reporting.

chunks.title: [FIXTURE] Germany on intellectual property
chunks.text: FIXTURE: Germany considers patent protection essential for innovation and rejects compulsory licensing; it prefers donations and licensing agreements negotiated with manufacturers.

chunks.title: [FIXTURE] Japan on meaningful human control
chunks.text: FIXTURE: Japan supports a political declaration requiring meaningful human control over lethal autonomous weapons and opposes a total ban on research.
